# Bel Air Financing (belairfinancing.com)

> Mortgage strategy for high-value homes and complex borrowers across Bel Air, Beverly Hills, Holmby Hills, Brentwood, Pacific Palisades, Malibu, and the Los Angeles Westside. A luxury-market service of West Coast Capital Mortgage Inc.

Bel Air Financing is the Los Angeles estate-market arm of West Coast Capital Mortgage Inc., led by broker Anatoliy Kanevsky, based in the Los Angeles area. It specializes in super-jumbo financing, interest-only structures, asset-based and bank-statement qualifying, and self-employed borrowers buying or refinancing high-value homes on the Westside and South Bay.

- Market: Greater Los Angeles luxury / estate markets (Westside and South Bay)
- NMLS #2817729 · CA DRE Corporation License #02440065 · Broker Anatoliy Kanevsky NMLS #2775380 · CA DRE #01385024
- Contact: 310-654-1577 · Los Angeles area
- Equal Housing Opportunity. Rates and program availability change; nothing here is a commitment to lend.

## Strategies
- [Super-jumbo financing](https://belairfinancing.com/super-jumbo/): Large-balance loans for high-value homes.
- [Jumbo purchase](https://belairfinancing.com/strategies/jumbo-purchase/): Structuring a jumbo purchase.
- [Interest-only](https://belairfinancing.com/strategies/interest-only/): Interest-only structures for cash-flow management.
- [Asset-based](https://belairfinancing.com/strategies/asset-based/): Qualifying on assets rather than income.
- [Bank-statement](https://belairfinancing.com/strategies/bank-statement/): Income from deposits for self-employed borrowers.
- [Self-employed](https://belairfinancing.com/strategies/self-employed/): Qualifying options for business owners.
